name: Kipperlilly Copperkettle
source: If Kristen calling Kipperlilly Copperkettle "four different dogs" the moment they met wasn't bad enough, Kristen's adventuring party also killed Kipperlilly and chose to leave her in hell. Rumor has it that Kipperlilly has been stuck doing community service since her return to the mortal plane.
